thesis: AMPH is a clean uptrend with accelerating fundamentals and a cheap valuation, which is rare in a risk-off tape where QQQ is below its 50- and 200-day averages. Quarterly revenue growth has stepped up from 0.4% to 5.4% to 8.2% YoY and Q3 net income recovered sharply, yet forward P/E is only 8.57. The entry is deliberately set on a pullback to 27.5-28.4 rather than chasing the rejected 31.0 spike, giving a reward/risk of 2.26 with a defined invalidation at 26.6. This is a moderate, not a high-conviction, thesis: the regime is hostile, news is unavailable, short interest is high and the post-earnings run may be partly priced in, so it should only be acted on if the pullback entry fills.
